About ODS to PDF

Turn an OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods) into a PDF of its cell values, laid out row by row so the data stays readable.

How it works

  1. 1Add the .ods file.
  2. 2Press Convert.
  3. 3Download the PDF.

Common questions

Are charts and formatting included?

No — values only. Export from LibreOffice Calc for a formatted PDF.

What about several sheets?

Each sheet becomes its own section in the PDF.

Excel files?

Use Excel to PDF; it works the same way.
